Enum Class GamepadButton

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<GamepadButton>
input.GamepadButton
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<GamepadButton>, Constable
public enum GamepadButton extends Enum<GamepadButton>
A button of a game controller; the four directions of the left stick and of the arrows count as buttons.

Each button knows the name printed on it on Xbox controllers and on PlayStation controllers.

    DOWN
    The stick or the arrows pushed down.
    L3

    LEFT

    LT

    R3

    RIGHT
    The stick or the arrows pushed right.
    RT

    START

    UP
